fields.summary: Autonomous plan run (2026-11-06) for change set 01M6QBS, letting the daemon's web UI listen on all interfaces so a Caddy reverse proxy on another host can reach it. No owner took part; the change set's intent carries the owner's filed words. The agent raised three questions in one message to the arbiter: which intent the change set serves and what becomes of milestone 28's done point m28-read-only ('binds only to 127.0.0.1'); which values rhiza.web.host accepts; and whether the landed leaves web-serve-loopback and web-url-in-daemon-status are amended or replaced. The arbiter ruled in Decision web-host-setting-shape: serve milestone-28 and amend m28-read-only in place; accept only literal IPv4 or IPv6 addresses checked with net.ParseIP, rejecting empty values, hostnames including localhost, and values with a port; amend both leaves in place, with status showing http://<host>:<port>, IPv6 bracketed. The UI stays read-only.
fields.title: Plan of change set 01M6QBS: the web UI host setting (autonomous)
